scene: The glass cart rolls to a bustling transport plaza on the city rim.
picture: Pixel art flat side-scrolling view of a wide frozen dock and rim plaza. Far left, a chairlift boarding post with an empty swinging chair. Left-centre, the lanky boy in orange puffer vest and kite stands facing right. Centre, a glass-bottomed boat floats beside a pier. Far right, a brightly striped hot-air balloon is tethered.
shown: a swinging hillside chairlift seat hanging from an iron cable on the far left
a moored glass-bottomed boat rocking beside a frosty wooden pier in the centre
a striped hot-air balloon tethered and puffing steam on the far right
